_doc: CA charter school muni obligor universe — scoping pass for detector-composition framework
_methodology: Compiled May 2026 from CSFA conduit issuance records, CMFA/CSCDA/CalPFA TEFRA notices, EMMA obligor searches (manual), Bond Buyer & Ziegler/Piper Sandler/RBC press releases, CDE Charter Schools Division authorizer database, ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer (Form 990 + Schedule K), and individual operator websites. Universe focuses on operators with confirmed publicly-traded conduit revenue bonds outstanding 2024-2026.
_caveats: (1) Charter school conduit issuance is dispersed across CSFA, CMFA, CSCDA, CalPFA, and occasionally school-district conduits — no single obligor list exists. (2) Many smaller CA charters access muni via pooled financings (CSFA pooled programs, ExED pool) that obscure obligor-level outstanding par. (3) Form 990 Schedule K is the most reliable obligor-level disclosure but lags by 18-24 months. (4) Confidence levels indicate verification depth within search budget; HIGH = multiple corroborating public sources; MEDIUM = single confident source; LOW = name known to issue but specific series unconfirmed in this pass.

obligors.name: Aspire Public Schools
obligors._notes: Largest CA charter operator by enrollment (~16,000 students). Originally California + Memphis TN; divested Memphis 2017. Multi-authorizer footprint = exposure diversified. Type: classroom-based, K-12. Operator has been investment-grade rated historically (BBB- range). Form 990 Schedule K should disclose all outstanding par.
